license: Reuses the project's existing foliage texture sources; no external texture downloaded.

maps.jungle_leaf_flower_base_color.png: sRGB RGBA; 2x2 atlas from native 512px source maps: leaf, derived red/bronze flower, fine fern and pinnate palm; 512x256 fern/palm maps centered in their 512px cells; original alpha silhouettes retained
maps.jungle_leaf_flower_normal_gl.png: OpenGL tangent normal; approved leaf, fern and palm normal maps; leaf normal reused by flower variant
maps.jungle_leaf_flower_roughness.png: Linear grayscale; authored per region from source luminance and edge detail; glossy leaf/palm and satin fern/flowers
